children: Lane Nick, an Officer and President of Equitable Financial, sold 14,923 shares of Common Stock at a weighted average price of $53.2412 per share. The total sale amount reported was $794,518. Following the transaction, Lane Nick directly beneficially owned 110,006 shares, which total includes Restricted Stock Units. The filing states the trades were executed in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $53.225 to $53.29 and that the weighted average price is reported above.
